priorR7Disposition.assessment: The design now permits exactly one idempotent cleanup retire for the same attempt/reply and the commands/outbox/runtime_commands rows required by ordinary delivery. It explicitly withdraws the impossible blanket no-new-outbox assertion. Current schema requires non-null command/outbox IDs, unique project/outbox, and their foreign keys; create cannot lend its used outbox ID to a second runtime command. Stop replay creates no new dispatch. The correction does not authorize a new Ask/create/execution, attempt, reservation, provider/model call or allowance reset. Count-one-after-hello/repeated-hello/replayed-receipt controls are stated. Core owner must bind the additive retire kind/wire, writer/idempotency and held Binding297/299 alignment within the accepted source window. This is a future implementation obligation, not a remaining defect in the bounded proposal.

Current-root empty now requires both a successful admission drain and the per-attempt spawn fence: no unreaped launcher held by this bridge, and a one-spawn claim. Stop remains outcome_unknown/stopping while its own launcher is held before admission/mkdir. Retire retains the same guard and the independent relay-closed barrier; deletion and all acknowledgement predicates remain in order. Fresh rechecks cover retained ReplyChild and new instances without replaying stale success. Sealed-root empty continues to use its drain, because no subsequent admission can verify the removed generation name. The no-future-admission assertion is now scoped accordingly. Adverse pre-seeded-empty controls cover before admit-open, before SH, after SH/before mkdir, release/reap, next Stop/one retire/full barrier and sealed-root control. Prior finding was an honest-Stop proof gap, not a demonstrated purge race; no such race, duplicate claim, late home or provider call is claimed here.

acceptedDirectionsRetained: Choice(c): bridge owns fd3 relay and reply accounting; resident launcher uses held pidfd identity, never numeric reply signals. No goal-path redesign.

Namespace seal plus admission drain for renamed roots; current empty requires drain and spawn fence; current absence requires spawn fence and old roots sealed/drained. Whole leases use life lock and verified-gone entries; zero/torn launcher records remain unresolved.

Scoped live proof requires own exact home and fresh spawn nonce plus observed settled launcher exit. Exit71 never proves the occupied home. Locator uses no-link root/home checks and all-roots fallback on rename/duplicate home.

Fresh per-evaluation bounded check remains possible after original t0/deadline elapsed, on retained same-instance ReplyChild as well as new instance. Original stop/kill/shared-settle clocks and allowance are not restarted. Implementation must measure classifier-check budget separately from prior process/settle clock.
All pending settles answered or shared deadline before terminal receipt, never first-answer success; no resend after terminal receipt, uncertain accounting retained.

Eight named API predicates plus separately relayclosed; actual terminal writer and answered create required, capture:none only absent turn/end in both journal and database. No fabricated receipt or database-state substitute for process proof.

P1-E remains withdrawn. Atomic hello lease-loss table remains optional core/ledger design; removing it requires accounting-safe claim-before-rejected replay behavior. Cleanup is not a second execution.
